newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS lowers business class fares to Europe.
newsitem.headline: SAS lowers business class fares to Europe.

text.p: Scandinavian airline SAS said on Tuesday it was lowering prices, effective April 23, on business travel between Scandinavia and Europe.
It has also launched a new type of ticket, EuroSaver, which gives the same privileges as a full price ticket but at a lower price.
"The only restriction is that both the outgoing and return trips must be made with SAS," the airline said in a statement.
EuroSaver will make tickets up to 25 percent cheaper than the fully priced tickets.
For example a business class ticket between Stockholm and Paris would cost 9,625 crowns ($1,260), Stockholm-London 6,940 crowns and Gothenburg-Brussels 7.795 crowns.
